name: Glass post thread
oneLiner: three posts from the same account land one under another on tilted glass cards, a lit wire draws down from avatar to avatar as each one arrives, then a pulse of light runs the whole thread, lighting every like and stamping the 3/3 chip
say: when the speaker says 'I wrote a thread about this' or walks through a point in three beats: each post lands on a beat, the pulse runs down on the payoff. t1-t3 are the three posts, short (2 lines max)
